regions.name: National
regions.where: Whole country (calendar has no regional titles and no locator map)

planting.name: Land prep. and planting: winter crops

regions.notes: Lean box drawn in two pieces (Dec and Jan-Feb), recorded as one Dec-Feb season. Planting bar starts on the mid-Oct tick. The winter-crop bar combines land preparation and planting and falls after the rains (no rainy season); no separate winter-crop harvest bar is drawn. Frost risk (mid-May to Aug) and green harvest (Mar) not recorded. Edges at or near a mid-month tick, counted as covering the month (share of that month covered in brackets): Planting (Oct 51%).

assign.method: Single national calendar with no regional titles; every district mapped to 'national'.

transcriber_notes: Planting start is exactly mid-Oct (counted as Oct).
